definitions: A professional responsible for identifying, negotiating, and securing short-term or temporary leases for retail spaces, often within shopping centers or malls.
An individual who manages the leasing of non-traditional retail spaces, such as kiosks, pop-up shops, and seasonal stores.
examples: The Specialty Leasing Executive secured a prime location for the holiday pop-up.
Our team includes a dedicated Specialty Leasing Executive to maximize temporary revenue.
She started her career as a Specialty Leasing Executive before moving into permanent leasing.
